text:
mira: hitting a POC blocker with ACME - their demo returns 403 when calling /v1/generate, says "invalid_project" in logs

devon: can you paste the curl they're running?

mira: they shared this:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_trial_ABC123' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Org: org-999' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large","input":"hi"}'

jordan: 403 + "invalid_project" usually means the API key's org doesn't match X-Redwood-Org header or the key is a shadow (trial) key tied to a different tenant.

samir: @mira can you confirm the org id on the customer's console? trial keys often map to org-001 in our infra.

mira: they say they used the org id from the onboarding email (org-999). i'll ask them to screenshot the console.

sec-bot: NOTE: security questionnaire flag - ensure no long-lived service key is shared in screenshots. ask them to blur token values.

devon: while we wait, run a quick verify with an internal ok key: replace with a valid key and see if header mismatch reproduces.

mira: customer tried swapping to a different key and got 401 -> "invalid_key". so two issues?

jordan: sounds like they have a stale trial key that was rotated. Two parallel problems: a) their header org doesn't match the key's tenant, b) they have a shadow key that lacks the generate scope.

samir: quick repro steps:
1) create a test key scoped to project: curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/v1/keys -H 'Authorization: Bearer @ops' -d '{"scopes":["generate"]}'
2) call generate with X-Redwood-Org set to that key's org
Expect: 200

mira: i asked them to generate a fresh org-scoped key from console and to remove X-Redwood-Org header if they're using project-scoped key. waiting on response.

devon: logging note: if you see "authz.scope_missing:generate" in our logs that means key missing the model/generate scope. if present, we'll need ops to reissue key with correct scopes.

mira: customer confirmed: they were using the onboarding email's org id for a different workspace. new key fixed it, they can call generate. :tada:

jordan: next steps: send the customer a short checklist -> key type (trial vs service), required headers (X-Redwood-Org vs X-Redwood-Project), and how to rotate keys.

mira: will do and close the POC ticket. thanks team.
